scored.answer: The truck arrives at Dock 1 and begins to open its doors, but there is no mention of it backing into the dock door.
At 06:15:27, a group of brown boxes on the rightmost shelf in Aisle 3 begins to fall and scatter to the floor.
At 26:30.0–27:00.0, a blue cylindrical object rolls into the aisle and comes to rest on the floor, leaving a small puddle behind.
The fire exit is blocked by a pallet of red boxes appearing at the right side of the warehouse floor near the exit and remaining there until the end of the sequence.
